description: Ask an entry for an appointment for the user, such as a visit, a consultation or a demo. It is a request: the entry's owner confirms a time, or suggests another. Only for entries whose actions (get_entry_sections) list request_appointment. Ask the user for their name and email address. Nothing is sent by this call: the user sends it on Daawid's page, with a code Daawid emails them. Give the user the link from the answer.

actionId.description: Which of its actions of this kind (get_entry_sections), when it has several.

answers.description: Answers to the action's own questions (get_entry_sections), by their keys.

entry.description: Which entry: its ID or slug, from search or get_entry.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own key for this request: the same key and details within 24 hours give the same request.

offeringId.description: Which of the entry's offerings (get_entry_sections) it is about, if one.

postalCode.description: The postal code, when it is at the user's place or the action asks for one.

preferredSlots.description: Times that suit the user: 1 to 5 windows.

from.description: Start, with the user's UTC offset: "2026-11-05T09:00:00+01:00".

purpose.description: What it is for, in the user's words and language. Don't add what they didn't say, such as features from the entry.

email.description: The user's email address, for the code and the answer. Ask them; don't guess.

name.description: The user's name. Ask them; don't guess.

phone.description: Their phone number with its country code, "+1 212 555 0123", if they give it.

preferredChannel.description: How they'd like to be answered, if they say.

name: request_appointment
title: Request an appointment
